extractedItems.title: What advice can you ask for on the course?
extractedItems.question: You are standing on the fairway and can’t see the flag. What are you allowed to ask your friend to do?

choices.text: Ask them which club they think you should use.
Ask them to indicate the line of play to the flag.
Ask them what shot to play.
Ask them to read the rules for you aloud.

extractedItems.explanation: You are allowed to ask someone to indicate the line of play if you can't see the flag. You can't ask for advice about which club or shot to play.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage golfer standing on the fairway with a friend pointing out the direction of the flag, no clubs being discussed.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen golfer on the fairway with friend pointing out the flag direction.

extractedItems.title: Penalty for giving or asking for advice
extractedItems.question: Before hitting your shot, you ask your playing partner, 'Which club should I play?' What is the correct outcome?

choices.text: No penalty for either player.
You get 2 penalty strokes.
Your partner gets 2 penalty strokes.
Both you and your partner get 1 penalty stroke.

extractedItems.explanation: Asking for or giving advice about club selection results in a 2-stroke penalty for the player who asks or receives the advice.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage golfer on the fairway talking to a friend and asking for advice about which club to use.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen golfer holding a club and asking friend for club choice advice.

extractedItems.title: What happens if you get advice without asking?
extractedItems.question: Imagine another player gives you advice before your shot, even though you didn’t ask for it. What penalty do you get?

choices.text: No penalty.
1 penalty stroke.
2 penalty strokes.
Both players get 2 penalty strokes.

extractedItems.explanation: A player who receives unsolicited advice does not get a penalty.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage golfer looking surprised as another player offers advice while standing on the fairway.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen golfer surprised as another player gives unasked advice on fairway.

extractedItems.ruleName: Ball moved when taking a practice swing
extractedItems.title: What happens if you move your ball on a practice swing?
extractedItems.question: You accidentally move your ball while taking a practice swing on the fairway. What must you do next?

choices.text: Play the ball from its new position.
Put the ball back and add 1 penalty stroke.
Do nothing, no penalty.
Move the ball to a better spot.

extractedItems.explanation: You must replace the ball and add 1 penalty stroke if you move it with a practice swing.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage golfer accidentally moving their ball while practising a swing on the fairway.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen golfer brushing the ball with a club on a practice swing on fairway.
